summary: Northgate Web Studio will keep Willow Lane Florist's website content up to date, apply security updates and fix reported errors within two business days. The agreement runs for six months from the date Willow Lane Florist signs it, then ends without renewing. Either side can end it at any time with thirty days' written notice, and there is no fee for ending it early. Willow Lane Florist pays $300 a month, invoiced at the start of each month. The fee stays the same for the whole term, and any change to the agreement needs both sides to agree in writing. Invoices unpaid after thirty days carry interest of 1% a month. Each side's total liability is limited to the fees Willow Lane Florist paid in the three months before a claim. Willow Lane Florist owns all content on its website, and Northgate hands over every login and file within five business days after the agreement ends. Ohio law applies.
